purpose: Post-hoc speed and convergence investigation requested by user; fresh isolated timing run with unchanged v11 science and numerical controls. Preserve all earlier measured runs.
expected: All saved numerical arrays and candidate values match retained v11; compare after worker exits. No reference feedback or search control changes.
data_policy: Large data/products external, source files unchanged; references only graded in the existing parent after worker exit.
timing_policy: Exclusive function-boundary wall times partition each process. Native worker/streaming I/O time belongs to owning stage; nested inclusive times are never added. Run separately from convergence probes.
